name: Holstein Cattle
summary: A mammal recorded in Leonida. Its entry places the cattle on central Leonida farmland and says it cannot be hunted for profit.
description: Holstein Cattle are part of Leonida’s dairy industry and are found on central Leonida farmland. These location and interaction details have not been independently confirmed in-game.
